title: ACDR: Fix handling of short signaling packets
description:
HOST --> PSTN layout is different than PSTN --> HOST.

The layout of HOST --> PSTN is:
```
BE16 - OpCode
BE16 - Data Size
REST - Data
```

(cherry picked from commit 93b3f3b5757857ab32885d186d1649323c589f45)
